## abyssctl version

Show the version, commit, Go version, platform and Caddy pin of this binary

### Synopsis

Shows the values compiled into this binary: its Abyss version, the commit it was built from, the Go
version, the platform and the pinned Caddy version and digest.

It needs no root, takes no lock, reads no file and makes no network or Docker call. It is not logged.

With --json it prints the version document on stdout instead, with "schema": 1.

```
abyssctl version [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  abyssctl version
  abyssctl version --json
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for version
      --json   print the version document as JSON
```
